name: Maraudon Normal: releasing at Landslide revives at the Pristine Waters start, not the Wicked Grotto (#7004)
contract: A player who releases in a Normal dungeon is revived with half health at the nearest Dungeon Finder start of
the wings on that map (AscensionDungeonRelease, #7123). Maraudon's Normal wings start at Orange
(1019.69, -458.31), Purple, the Wicked Grotto side (752.91, -616.53), and Pristine Waters (495.702, 17.3372)
in lfg_dungeon_template; the area triggers 3133 and 3134 lead to the Orange and Purple starts. From
Landslide's spawn (356.681, -185.455) Pristine Waters is about 246 yards away, Purple about 585 and Orange
about 717, so a player who dies there is revived on map 349 at the Pristine Waters start. The report's core
predated #7123 and sent the player to the Purple start (#7004); this already works and guards the behaviour.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Maraudon
